description: Single-Spark TangoFlux job: one text prompt in, one stereo 44.1 kHz 16-bit WAV out (1 to 30 seconds; the model writes at most 29.95 s). The job runs the creator's own steps with its defaults: FLAN-T5-large encodes the prompt, the 515M-parameter FluxTransformer denoises 50 flow-matching steps at guidance 4.5 (the creator's CLI and generate() defaults; its CLI allows 10 to 100 steps), and the Oobleck VAE decodes and trims to the requested length. The creator's generate() hard-wires the seed to 0; this recipe passes its seed knob through the creator's own inference_flow. The FLAN-T5 and VAE weights come from mounted files instead of snapshot_download, the load must show exactly the creator's expected single missing key (the text encoder's embed_tokens), and the clip is written as PCM through soundfile instead of torchaudio. The creator's torch 2.4 stack has no aarch64 sm_121 build, so the image runs the platform's torch 2.14 stack on CUDA 13.0, with the creator's datasets 2.21.0 and numpy 1.26.4 (and pyarrow 20, the newest that imports under NumPy 1). The code and weights are under the Stability AI Community License (research and non-commercial use, free below USD 1M annual revenue), and the training data includes WavCaps, which is academic-use only. It overlaps the Stable Audio 3 Small SFX recipe and is offered as an alternative to compare. Recorded for information, never gated.
